summary: FINAL VIEWINGS 8TH AUGUST Occupying a commanding elevated position, with far reaching views across the Solway Plain towards the Lake District Fells, an excellent opportunity to acquire a deceptively spacious, 2 bedroom detached bungalow, with generous gardens, 2 garages & fields to the front & rear, in all circa 6.06 acres
description:
Available with approximately 6.06 acres of land, Raegarth is an attractive detached bungalow occupying a peaceful rural setting, enjoying panoramic views across open countryside.

Offered to the market with no onward chain, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a manageable country property with adjoining land, perfectly suited to equestrian use, hobby farming or those simply seeking space, privacy and a rural lifestyle.

Conveniently positioned for easy access to Brampton, Carlisle and Longtown, the property combines the tranquillity of country living with excellent day-to-day accessibility. The bungalow is presented in well-maintained, neutral decorative order throughout and offers well-proportioned accommodation, together with exciting scope to extend or remodel, subject to the necessary planning permissions.

The property sits within generous gardens and benefits from ample driveway parking, twin garages and, most notably, ownership of the adjoining fields to both the front and rear. The land is level, well drained and easily managed, making it ideal for equestrian pursuits, grazing or a variety of lifestyle uses.

Internally, a central entrance hall leads to a spacious dual-aspect living room, with an attractive stone fireplace providing a focal point. The generous kitchen/dining room offers an excellent family and entertaining space, opening into a conservatory that enjoys uninterrupted views across the rear paddock. A separate utility room provides additional practicality and internal access to the integral garage.

There are two spacious double bedrooms, with the principal bedroom benefiting from an extensive range of fitted wardrobes and over-bed storage, complemented by a four-piece family bathroom.

Properties offering over six acres of adjoining land with a well-presented detached bungalow are increasingly difficult to find. Combining an enviable rural setting with excellent accessibility and considerable future potential, Raegarth represents an exceptional lifestyle opportunity, and early viewing is highly recommended.

Directions From Carlisle follow the A7 north turning right at Sandysike towards Cliff. On reaching the A6071 turn right and then left towards Easton. Keep following this road for 5.5 miles and at the T junction turn left and follow this road for 0.5 miles. The house is on the right hand side.
